crossRefs.note: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
For I am Yahweh who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
You shall not profane my holy name, but I will be made holy among the children of Israel. I am Yahweh who makes you…
who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. I am Yahweh.”

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.
translations.bsb: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan and to be your God.
translations.kjv: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.
translations.asv: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.
